Infer a semantic type for each profiled column

Source: R/semantic.R
infer_semantic_type.Rd

The categories are the roadmap's (identifier, date, code, free text, flag) plus a few that fall out naturally. Rules are deliberately simple and ordered; the result is a first draft for a person to confirm.

Usage

infer_semantic_type(profile, top = NULL)

Arguments

profile

A data frame with the statistics produced by db_profile().

top

A list of top-value data frames, one per row of profile, or NULL.

Value

A character vector, one semantic type per row.

Details

  • empty: no non-null values

  • constant: one distinct value

  • flag: boolean type, or at most two values that look like yes/no

  • datetime, date, time: by type, or text whose values parse as such

  • identifier: nearly unique, a key-like name with high uniqueness, or short strings with more than half their values distinct

  • code: short strings from a small set

  • category: longer labels from a small set

  • free_text: long or highly varied strings

  • count: integers; measure: other numerics

  • unknown: anything else (binary, LOB, complex types)
